card.text: K2-148 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-148b"
sources.quote: K2-148b is a confirmed super-Earth, probably rocky, closely orbiting a small orange dwarf star.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-148. Its orbit and size follow Hirano et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-148b"
sources.quote: It is the innermost of three Super-Earths around the star K2-148, which is in a wide binary pair with the M0.5V red dwarf EPIC 220194953.
